label.nso: Dijo le dijo tše di bolokilwego

title.en: Selling at Local Market: from listing to your first buyer
title.af: Verkoop by die Plaaslike mark: van advertensie tot jou eerste koper
title.zu: Ukuthengisa eMakethe yendawo: kusukela esikhangisweni kuya kumthengi wakho wokuqala
title.xh: Ukuthengisa kwiMarike yasekuhlaleni: ukusuka kwintengiso ukuya kumthengi wakho wokuqala
title.nso: Go rekiša Mmarakeng wa selegae: go tloga papatšong go ya go moreki wa gago wa mathomo

chapters.nso: Bareki ba gago ba ka mehla

en: Open Quick, go to [[Local Market]] and tap [[Sell something]]
Swipe the Quick door to Local Market. One tap starts your listing.
af: Maak Quick oop, gaan na [[Local Market]] en tik [[Sell something]]
Swiep die Quick-deur na Local Market. Een tik begin jou advertensie.
zu: Vula i-Quick, iya ku-[[Local Market]] bese uthepha [[Sell something]]
Swayipha umnyango we-Quick uye ku-Local Market. Ukuthepha kanye kuqala isikhangiso sakho.
xh: Vula i-Quick, yiya kwi-[[Local Market]] uze ucofe [[Sell something]]
Tyibilikisa ucango lwe-Quick uye kwi-Local Market. Ukucofa kanye kuqalisa intengiso yakho.
nso: Bula Quick, eya go [[Local Market]] o kgotle [[Sell something]]
Šutiša lebati la Quick go ya go Local Market. Go kgotla gatee go thoma papatšo ya gago.

en: Pick [[Food & preserves]]
Choose the kind of thing you sell.
af: Kies [[Food & preserves]]
Kies die soort ding wat jy verkoop.
zu: Khetha [[Food & preserves]]
Khetha uhlobo lwento oyithengisayo.
xh: Khetha [[Food & preserves]]
Khetha uhlobo lwento oyithengisayo.
nso: Kgetha [[Food & preserves]]
Kgetha mohuta wa selo seo o se rekišago.

en: Tap your area
A buyer looking in your area finds you. Tap [[Another option]] to type yours if it is not listed.
af: Tik jou area
'n Koper wat in jou area soek, vind jou. Tik [[Another option]] om joune in te tik as dit nie gelys is nie.
zu: Thepha indawo yakho
Umthengi osesha endaweni yakho uyakuthola. Thepha [[Another option]] ukuze ubhale eyakho uma ingekho ohlwini.
xh: Cofa indawo yakho
Umthengi okhangela kwindawo yakho uyakufumana. Cofa [[Another option]] ukuze ubhale eyakho ukuba ayikho kuluhlu.
nso: Kgotla lefelo la gago
Moreki yo a nyakago lefelong la gago o a go hwetša. Kgotla [[Another option]] go ngwala la gago ge le se lenaneong.

en: Type your exact price
Tap [[Another option]], type your price, like R95, and tap [[Next]]. Buyers see exactly what you type.
af: Tik jou presiese prys
Tik [[Another option]], tik jou prys, soos R95, en tik [[Next]]. Kopers sien presies wat jy tik.
zu: Bhala inani lakho eliqondile
Thepha [[Another option]], bhala inani lakho, njenge-R95, bese uthepha [[Next]]. Abathengi babona khona kanye lokho okubhalayo.
xh: Bhala ixabiso lakho elichanekileyo
Cofa [[Another option]], bhala ixabiso lakho, njenge-R95, uze ucofe [[Next]]. Abathengi babona kanye le nto uyibhalayo.
nso: Ngwala theko ya gago ye e nepagetšego
Kgotla [[Another option]], ngwala theko ya gago, bjalo ka R95, o kgotle [[Next]]. Bareki ba bona seo o se ngwalago tlwa.

en: Say how they get it
[[Collect]], [[I deliver]], [[Post it]] or [[Market day]].
af: Sê hoe hulle dit kry
[[Collect]], [[I deliver]], [[Post it]] of [[Market day]].
zu: Yisho ukuthi bakuthola kanjani
[[Collect]], [[I deliver]], [[Post it]] noma [[Market day]].
xh: Yitsho ukuba bayifumana njani
[[Collect]], [[I deliver]], [[Post it]] okanye [[Market day]].
nso: Bolela gore ba e hwetša bjang
[[Collect]], [[I deliver]], [[Post it]] goba [[Market day]].

en: Say exactly what it is, add your first name and email, then save
Type what you sell, like 'Raw honey, 500 g jar': it becomes your title and the first words of your listing. Then tap [[Save my listing]]. No password.
af: Sê presies wat dit is, gee jou voornaam en e-pos, en stoor
Tik wat jy verkoop, soos 'Rou heuning, 500 g-fles': dit word jou titel en die eerste woorde van jou advertensie. Tik dan [[Save my listing]]. Geen wagwoord nie.
zu: Yisho ukuthi kuyini ngqo, faka igama lakho lokuqala ne-imeyili, bese ulondoloza
Bhala lokho okuthengisayo, njengokuthi 'Uju oluluhlaza, imbiza engu-500 g': kuba yisihloko sakho namagama okuqala esikhangiso sakho. Bese uthepha [[Save my listing]]. Akukho phasiwedi.
xh: Yitsho kanye ukuba yintoni, faka igama lakho lokuqala ne-imeyile, uze ugcine
Bhala oko ukuthengisayo, njengokuthi 'Ubusi obukrwada, ingqayi ye-500 g': iba sisihloko sakho namagama okuqala entengiso yakho. Emva koko cofa [[Save my listing]]. Akukho phasiwedi.
nso: Bolela gore ke eng tlwa, tsenya leina la gago la mathomo le imeile, o boloke
Ngwala seo o se rekišago, bjalo ka 'Todi ya tlhago, nkgwana ya 500 g': e ba hlogo ya gago le mantšu a mathomo a papatšo ya gago. Ke moka o kgotle [[Save my listing]]. Ga go phasewete.

en: Saved: now sign the terms and publish
Tap [[Sign the terms and publish]], or open the email we sent you. Nobody can see your listing yet.
af: Gestoor: teken nou die terme en publiseer
Tik [[Sign the terms and publish]], of maak die e-pos oop wat ons gestuur het. Niemand kan jou advertensie nog sien nie.
zu: Kulondoloziwe: manje sayina imigomo bese ushicilela
Thepha [[Sign the terms and publish]], noma uvule i-imeyili esikuthumelele yona. Akekho ongasibona isikhangiso sakho okwamanje.
xh: Kugciniwe: ngoku tyikitya imiqathango uze upapashe
Cofa [[Sign the terms and publish]], okanye uvule i-imeyile esikuthumelele yona. Akukho mntu unokuyibona intengiso yakho okwangoku.
nso: E bolokilwe: bjale saena mabaka o phatlalatše
Kgotla [[Sign the terms and publish]], goba o bule imeile yeo re go romeletšego yona. Ga go yo a ka bonago papatšo ya gago ga bjale.

en: Add your own photo
In TrustSquare tap [[Edit]], add a photo of your jar with no writing on it, and tap [[Save Changes]].
af: Voeg jou eie foto by
Tik in TrustSquare [[Edit]], voeg 'n foto van jou fles sonder skrif daarop by, en tik [[Save Changes]].
zu: Faka isithombe sakho
Ku-TrustSquare thepha [[Edit]], faka isithombe sembiza yakho esingenakho ukubhala, bese uthepha [[Save Changes]].
xh: Faka eyakho ifoto
Kwi-TrustSquare cofa [[Edit]], faka ifoto yengqayi yakho engenambhalo, uze ucofe [[Save Changes]].
nso: Tsenya seswantšho sa gago
Go TrustSquare kgotla [[Edit]], tsenya seswantšho sa nkgwana ya gago se se se nago mongwalo, o kgotle [[Save Changes]].

en: Accept the seller terms once
Read them, tick both boxes at the end and tap [[I accept]].
af: Aanvaar die verkopersterme een keer
Lees dit, merk albei blokkies aan die einde en tik [[I accept]].
zu: Yamukela imigomo yomthengisi kanye
Yifunde, maka omabhokisi ababili ekugcineni bese uthepha [[I accept]].
xh: Yamkela imiqathango yomthengisi kube kanye
Yifunde, phawula iibhokisi ezimbini ekugqibeleni uze ucofe [[I accept]].
nso: Amogela mabaka a morekiši gatee
A bale, swaya mapokisi a mabedi mafelelong o kgotle [[I accept]].

en: Publish
Tap [[Publish my listing]]. It is live at once: anyone looking in Local Market can find it.
af: Publiseer
Tik [[Publish my listing]]. Dit is dadelik lewendig: enigiemand wat in Local Market soek, kan dit vind.
zu: Shicilela
Thepha [[Publish my listing]]. Siphila ngokushesha: noma ubani obheka ku-Local Market angasithola.
xh: Papasha
Cofa [[Publish my listing]]. Iphila kwangoko: nabani na okhangela kwi-Local Market unokuyifumana.
nso: Phatlalatša
Kgotla [[Publish my listing]]. E phela gateetee: mang le mang yo a nyakago go Local Market a ka e hwetša.

en: Send your Buzz link to your regulars
In [[My Space]], open [[Buzz]], add your first name once and tap [[Get my link]]. One link for all your regular customers: [[Send on WhatsApp]] or [[Copy]].
af: Stuur jou Buzz-skakel aan jou vaste kliënte
Maak [[Buzz]] in [[My Space]] oop, gee jou voornaam een keer en tik [[Get my link]]. Een skakel vir al jou vaste kliënte: [[Send on WhatsApp]] of [[Copy]].
zu: Thumela isixhumanisi sakho se-Buzz kumakhasimende akho ajwayelekile
Ku-[[My Space]], vula i-[[Buzz]], faka igama lakho lokuqala kanye bese uthepha [[Get my link]]. Isixhumanisi esisodwa sawo wonke amakhasimende akho: [[Send on WhatsApp]] noma [[Copy]].
xh: Thumela ikhonkco lakho le-Buzz kubathengi bakho abaqhelekileyo
Kwi-[[My Space]], vula i-[[Buzz]], faka igama lakho lokuqala kube kanye uze ucofe [[Get my link]]. Ikhonkco elinye labo bonke abathengi bakho: [[Send on WhatsApp]] okanye [[Copy]].
nso: Romela kgokagano ya gago ya Buzz go bareki ba gago ba ka mehla
Go [[My Space]], bula [[Buzz]], tsenya leina la gago la mathomo gatee o kgotle [[Get my link]]. Kgokagano e tee ya bareki ba gago ka moka: [[Send on WhatsApp]] goba [[Copy]].

en: Your regular joins
She taps the link, ticks the Buzz terms, adds her first name and signs in with a code. You are connected, and it costs nothing.
af: Jou vaste kliënt sluit aan
Sy tik die skakel, merk die Buzz-terme, gee haar voornaam en teken met 'n kode in. Julle is verbind, en dit kos niks.
zu: Ikhasimende lakho elijwayelekile liyajoyina
Uthepha isixhumanisi, amake imigomo ye-Buzz, afake igama lakhe lokuqala bese engena ngekhodi. Nixhumene, futhi akubizi lutho.
xh: Umthengi wakho oqhelekileyo uyajoyina
Ucofa ikhonkco, aphawule imiqathango ye-Buzz, afake igama lakhe lokuqala aze angene ngekhowudi. Niqhagamshelene, kwaye akubizi nto.
nso: Moreki wa gago wa ka mehla o a tsena
O kgotla kgokagano, a swaya mabaka a Buzz, a tsenya leina la gagwe la mathomo gomme a tsena ka khoutu. Le kgokagane, gomme ga go bitše selo.

en: She buzzes you an order
One line, straight to your phone, with her name on it: 'Two jars please, I collect on Saturday'.
af: Sy buzz vir jou 'n bestelling
Een reël, reguit na jou foon, met haar naam daarop: 'Twee flesse asseblief, ek haal Saterdag'.
zu: Ukuthumelela i-oda nge-Buzz
Umugqa owodwa, uqonde ocingweni lwakho, unegama lakhe: 'Izimbiza ezimbili ngicela, ngizolanda ngoMgqibelo'.
xh: Ukuthumelela iodolo nge-Buzz
Umgca omnye, ngqo kwifowuni yakho, unegama lakhe: 'Iingqayi ezimbini nceda, ndiza kuzilanda ngoMgqibelo'.
nso: O go romela odara ka Buzz
Mothalo o tee, thwii mogaleng wa gago, o na le leina la gagwe: 'Dinkgwana tše pedi hle, ke tla di tšea ka Mokibelo'.

en: A new buyer finds you
She finds your honey in Local Market by area, and sees your price and your Trust Score.
af: 'n Nuwe koper vind jou
Sy vind jou heuning in Local Market volgens area, en sien jou prys en jou Trust Score.
zu: Umthengi omusha uyakuthola
Uthola uju lwakho ku-Local Market ngendawo, abone inani lakho ne-Trust Score yakho.
xh: Umthengi omtsha uyakufumana
Ufumana ubusi bakho kwi-Local Market ngendawo, abone ixabiso lakho ne-Trust Score yakho.
nso: Moreki yo moswa o a go hwetša
O hwetša todi ya gago go Local Market go ya ka lefelo, a bona theko ya gago le Trust Score ya gago.

en: She can check your price
[[Market check]] reads real shop prices for items like yours and names every shop. It costs her 1T, and only if it finds real prices.
af: Sy kan jou prys nagaan
[[Market check]] lees regte winkelpryse vir items soos joune en noem elke winkel. Dit kos haar 1T, en net as dit regte pryse vind.
zu: Angahlola inani lakho
I-[[Market check]] ifunda amanani angempela ezitolo ezintweni ezifana nezakho futhi isho isitolo ngasinye. Kumbiza i-1T, kuphela uma ithola amanani angempela.
xh: Angalijonga ixabiso lakho
I-[[Market check]] ifunda amaxabiso okwenyani eevenkile kwizinto ezifana nezakho kwaye ichaza ivenkile nganye. Imbiza i-1T, kuphela ukuba ifumana amaxabiso okwenyani.
nso: A ka lekola theko ya gago
[[Market check]] e bala ditheko tša nnete tša mabenkele tša dilo tše bjalo ka tša gago gomme e bolela lebenkele le lengwe le le lengwe. E mo bitša 1T, feela ge e hwetša ditheko tša nnete.

en: She asks for an introduction
She writes a short message; it is free for her. If she is not signed in yet, she signs in with a code and her message is kept.
af: Sy vra vir 'n bekendstelling
Sy skryf 'n kort boodskap; dit is gratis vir haar. As sy nog nie ingeteken is nie, teken sy met 'n kode in en haar boodskap word gehou.
zu: Ucela ukwethulwa
Ubhala umlayezo omfushane; kumahhala kuye. Uma engakangeni, ungena ngekhodi futhi umlayezo wakhe uyagcinwa.
xh: Ucela ukwaziswa
Ubhala umyalezo omfutshane; simahla kuye. Ukuba akakangeni, ungena ngekhowudi kwaye umyalezo wakhe uyagcinwa.
nso: O kgopela go tsebišwa
O ngwala molaetša o mokopana; ke mahala go yena. Ge a sešo a tsena, o tsena ka khoutu gomme molaetša wa gagwe o a bolokwa.

en: You see her request
Open [[My Space]], then [[Intros]].
af: Jy sien haar versoek
Maak [[My Space]] oop, dan [[Intros]].
zu: Ubona isicelo sakhe
Vula i-[[My Space]], bese [[Intros]].
xh: Ubona isicelo sakhe
Vula i-[[My Space]], emva koko [[Intros]].
nso: O bona kgopelo ya gagwe
Bula [[My Space]], ke moka [[Intros]].

en: Accept: 1T for your first buyer
Tap [[Accept]]. Your first buyer on this listing costs you 1T. If your wallet is empty, top up and then accept; her request waits for you.
af: Aanvaar: 1T vir jou eerste koper
Tik [[Accept]]. Jou eerste koper op hierdie advertensie kos jou 1T. As jou beursie leeg is, laai op en aanvaar dan; haar versoek wag vir jou.
zu: Yamukela: i-1T yomthengi wakho wokuqala
Thepha [[Accept]]. Umthengi wakho wokuqala kulesi sikhangiso ukubiza i-1T. Uma isikhwama sakho singenalutho, faka imali bese wamukela; isicelo sakhe siyakulinda.
xh: Yamkela: i-1T yomthengi wakho wokuqala
Cofa [[Accept]]. Umthengi wakho wokuqala kule ntengiso ukubiza i-1T. Ukuba isipaji sakho asinanto, faka imali uze wamkele; isicelo sakhe siyakulinda.
nso: Amogela: 1T ya moreki wa gago wa mathomo
Kgotla [[Accept]]. Moreki wa gago wa mathomo papatšong ye o go bitša 1T. Ge sepatšhe sa gago se se na selo, tlatša gomme o amogele; kgopelo ya gagwe e a go letela.

en: You are introduced
You both get an email: reply to it to talk. Your email address stays private.
af: Julle is voorgestel
Julle kry albei 'n e-pos: antwoord daarop om te praat. Jou e-posadres bly privaat.
zu: Nethuliwe
Nobabili nithola i-imeyili: phendula kuyo ukuze nikhulume. Ikheli lakho le-imeyili lihlala liyimfihlo.
xh: Niyaziswa
Nobabini nifumana i-imeyile: phendula kuyo ukuze nithethe. Idilesi yakho ye-imeyile ihlala iyimfihlo.
nso: Le tsebišitšwe
Le hwetša imeile ka bobedi: e arabe gore le boledišane. Aterese ya gago ya imeile e dula e le sephiri.

en: Pass Quick on
Tap [[Pass Quick on to someone]] and share it with a friend who sells like you.
af: Gee Quick aan
Tik [[Pass Quick on to someone]] en deel dit met 'n vriendin wat verkoop soos jy.
zu: Dlulisela i-Quick
Thepha [[Pass Quick on to someone]] bese uyabelana ngayo nomngane othengisa njengawe.
xh: Dlulisela i-Quick
Cofa [[Pass Quick on to someone]] uze wabelane ngayo nomhlobo othengisa njengawe.
nso: Fetišetša Quick pele
Kgotla [[Pass Quick on to someone]] o e abelane le mogwera yo a rekišago bjalo ka wena.
